content: निर्वापणम् .²1 An offering, oblation, a funeral oblation. .²2 A gift, donation. .²3 Putting out, extinguishing. .²4 Pouring out, scattering, sowing (as seed). .²5 .³({%a%}) Offering, giving. .³({%b%}) Offering oblations (especially funeral). .²6 Allaying, alleviation, pacification; कर्तव्यानि दुःखितैर्दुःखनिर्वापणानि <ls>U. 3</ls>. .²7 Annihilation. .²8 Killing, slaughter. .²9 Cooling, refreshing; शरीरनिर्वापणाय <ls>Ś. 3</ls>. .²10 A refrigerant or cooling application; तप्तायःपिण्डसिकतानां वा निर्वापणं प्रसाधनं च कर्तव्यम्.
